{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check if any revenue values contain non-numeric characters
print("Revenue values with non-numeric characters:")
print(data[~data['revenue'].str.contains(r'^\d+,?\d*\.?\d*$', na=False)])

# Clean the revenue column
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status']])

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# Because refunded orders should not count as revenue or conversion success
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Final data shape
print(f"\nFinal data shape after cleaning: {data_clean.shape}")

# Check the cleaned revenue
print("\nSummary of cleaned revenue:")
print(data_clean['revenue_clean'].describe())"}
